parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no gender-presentation dress code, no facility/bathroom rule, no documented police sweeps or custody-placement practice against trans people — so no tier-1 universal exposure or organised targeting. The heaviest negatives are legal and societal: an in-force 'propaganda' ban (signed 30 Dec 2025) carrying 10-day arrest and fines, whose application to trans visibility is unresolved (an open question, weighted lightly rather than as a known exposure); documented hostility with thin recourse (an activist nearly run down with no investigation; an NGO denied registration; women who fled for months despite winning a privacy ruling); a hate-crime reporting gap with no national contact point; and no anti-discrimination protections anywhere. Counterweights: expression is lawful, courts sometimes act, and trans people are fleeing *into* this country from a worse neighbour — a relative-climate positive. Elevated Risk, upper band; below anchors with unremedied institutional exclusion or documented service-refusal at scale.
